heart.en: A muscular pump in the chest. Its right side sends blood to the lungs; its left side sends blood through the systemic circulation.
heart.zh: 胸腔内的肌肉泵。右侧将血液泵入肺部；左侧将血液泵入体循环。

liver.en: A large organ beneath the right side of the diaphragm. It processes absorbed nutrients, produces bile, and synthesizes many proteins carried in the blood.
liver.zh: 横膈膜右下方的大型器官。它处理吸收的营养、分泌胆汁，并合成血液中的许多蛋白质。

brain.en: The central organ of the nervous system. Its interconnected regions support perception, movement, memory, language, and the regulation of bodily functions.
brain.zh: 神经系统的中枢器官。其相互连接的区域支持感知、运动、记忆、语言以及身体机能的调节。

stomach.en: A muscular chamber between the esophagus and small intestine. It stores and mixes food with acid and enzymes before releasing it into the duodenum.
stomach.zh: 位于食道和小肠之间的肌肉腔室。它在将食物排入十二指肠前，将其与胃酸和酶混合并储存。

spleen.en: A lymphoid organ in the upper left abdomen. It filters blood, removes aging blood cells, and participates in immune responses.
spleen.zh: 左上腹的淋巴器官。它过滤血液，清除老化的血细胞，并参与免疫反应。

pancreas.en: An abdominal organ with digestive and endocrine roles. It supplies enzymes to the small intestine and releases hormones including insulin and glucagon.
pancreas.zh: 兼具消化和内分泌功能的腹部器官。它向小肠提供酶，并释放包括胰岛素和胰高血糖素在内的激素。

urinary bladder.en: A muscular reservoir in the pelvis that stores urine arriving from the kidneys through the ureters.
urinary bladder.zh: 位于骨盆内的肌肉性储尿器，用于储存从肾脏经输尿管流来的尿液。

trachea.en: The main airway connecting the larynx to the bronchi. Its cartilage supports keep the airway open during breathing.
trachea.zh: 连接喉部和支气管的主要气道。其软骨支撑在呼吸时保持气道畅通。

diaphragm.en: A broad muscle separating the chest and abdomen. When it contracts, it increases chest volume and helps draw air into the lungs.
diaphragm.zh: 分隔胸腔和腹腔的宽阔肌肉。当它收缩时，会增加胸腔体积，帮助将空气吸入肺部。

femur.en: The longest and strongest bone in the body, extending from the hip to the knee. It bears body weight during standing and walking.
femur.zh: 人体最长最强壮的骨骼，从髋部延伸至膝部。站立和行走时承受体重。

tibia.en: The larger bone of the lower leg, bearing most of the body weight. It articulates with the femur at the knee and the talus at the ankle.
tibia.zh: 小腿较大的骨骼，承受大部分体重。上端与股骨构成膝关节，下端与距骨构成踝关节。

fibula.en: The slender bone on the lateral side of the lower leg. It serves mainly as an attachment for muscles and helps stabilize the ankle.
fibula.zh: 小腿外侧的细长骨骼。主要作为肌肉附着点，并帮助稳定踝关节。

patella.en: A sesamoid bone embedded in the quadriceps tendon, forming the kneecap. It protects the knee joint and improves the leverage of the quadriceps.
patella.zh: 嵌入股四头肌腱中的籽骨，构成膝盖骨。保护膝关节并增强股四头肌的力学效率。

humerus.en: The long bone of the upper arm, connecting the shoulder to the elbow. It provides attachment for muscles that move the arm and forearm.
humerus.zh: 上臂的长骨，连接肩部与肘部。为驱动上臂和前臂运动的肌肉提供附着点。

radius.en: The lateral bone of the forearm. It rotates around the ulna to allow pronation and supination of the hand.
radius.zh: 前臂外侧的骨骼。它围绕尺骨旋转，使手能够进行旋前和旋后运动。

ulna.en: The medial bone of the forearm, forming the point of the elbow. It provides a stable axis for forearm rotation.
ulna.zh: 前臂内侧的骨骼，构成肘尖。为前臂旋转提供稳定的轴心。

scapula.en: A flat triangular bone on the upper back. It anchors several muscles that move the arm and stabilize the shoulder.
scapula.zh: 上背部的扁平三角形骨骼。锚定多条驱动上臂运动和稳定肩部的肌肉。

clavicle.en: A slender S-shaped bone connecting the sternum to the scapula. It acts as a strut to hold the shoulder laterally.
clavicle.zh: 连接胸骨和肩胛骨的细长S形骨骼。起到支撑作用，使肩部向外侧展开。

sternum.en: The flat bone at the center of the chest. It anchors the ribs anteriorly and protects the heart and great vessels.
sternum.zh: 位于胸部中央的扁平骨骼。在前方连接肋骨，保护心脏和大血管。

sacrum.en: A triangular bone at the base of the spine formed by five fused vertebrae. It transmits the weight of the trunk to the pelvis.
sacrum.zh: 由五块融合椎骨组成的位于脊柱底部的三角形骨骼。将躯干的重量传递至骨盆。

mandible.en: The lower jawbone and the only movable bone of the skull. It holds the lower teeth and enables chewing and speech.
mandible.zh: 下颌骨，头骨中唯一可活动的骨骼。承载下齿并使咀嚼和言语成为可能。

skull.en: The bony framework of the head, composed of cranial and facial bones. It encloses and protects the brain, eyes, and inner ears.
skull.zh: 头部的骨性框架，由颅骨和面骨组成。包裹并保护大脑、眼睛和内耳。

pelvis.en: A ring of bones formed by the hip bones, sacrum, and coccyx. It supports the trunk, protects pelvic organs, and transfers weight to the lower limbs.
pelvis.zh: 由髋骨、骶骨和尾骨组成的骨环。支撑躯干，保护盆腔器官，并将重量传递至下肢。

pectoralis major.en: A large fan-shaped muscle of the chest. It adducts, flexes, and medially rotates the arm at the shoulder.
pectoralis major.zh: 胸部的大扇形肌肉。使肩关节处的上臂内收、屈曲和内旋。

deltoid.en: The triangular muscle capping the shoulder. Its anterior, middle, and posterior fibers flex, abduct, and extend the arm respectively.
deltoid.zh: 覆盖肩部的三角形肌肉。其前部、中部和后部纤维分别使上臂屈曲、外展和伸展。

biceps brachii.en: A two-headed muscle on the front of the upper arm. It flexes the elbow and supinates the forearm.
biceps brachii.zh: 上臂前面的双头肌肉。屈肘并使前臂旋后。

triceps brachii.en: A three-headed muscle on the back of the upper arm. It is the primary extensor of the elbow.
triceps brachii.zh: 上臂后面的三头肌肉。是肘关节的主要伸展肌。

trapezius.en: A large diamond-shaped muscle of the upper back and neck. It elevates, retracts, and depresses the scapula and extends the neck.
trapezius.zh: 上背部和颈部的大菱形肌肉。使肩胛骨上提、后缩和下压，并伸展颈部。

latissimus dorsi.en: The broadest muscle of the back. It extends, adducts, and medially rotates the arm; important in pulling and climbing.
latissimus dorsi.zh: 背部最宽阔的肌肉。使上臂伸展、内收和内旋；在牵拉和攀爬动作中起关键作用。

rectus abdominis.en: The paired strap muscle running vertically along the front of the abdomen. It flexes the trunk and compresses abdominal contents.
rectus abdominis.zh: 沿腹部前面纵向排列的成对带状肌肉。屈曲躯干并压缩腹腔内容物。

external oblique.en: The largest and outermost abdominal wall muscle. It rotates and laterally flexes the trunk and compresses the abdomen.
external oblique.zh: 腹壁最大且最外层的肌肉。使躯干旋转和侧屈，并压缩腹部。

internal oblique.en: The middle layer of the lateral abdominal wall. It works with the external oblique to rotate and flex the trunk.
internal oblique.zh: 腹壁侧面的中层肌肉。与腹外斜肌协同完成躯干的旋转和屈曲。

gluteus maximus.en: The largest and most superficial muscle of the buttock. It powerfully extends and laterally rotates the hip, essential for rising from a seated position and climbing.
gluteus maximus.zh: 臀部最大且最表浅的肌肉。强力伸展和外旋髋关节，对站起和登高至关重要。

gluteus medius.en: A fan-shaped muscle on the lateral surface of the pelvis. It abducts the thigh and stabilizes the pelvis during walking.
gluteus medius.zh: 位于骨盆外侧面的扇形肌肉。使大腿外展，并在行走时稳定骨盆。

quadriceps femoris.en: The four-headed muscle group on the front of the thigh. It is the primary extensor of the knee and assists hip flexion.
quadriceps femoris.zh: 大腿前面的四头肌群。是膝关节的主要伸展肌，并辅助髋关节屈曲。

rectus femoris.en: The central muscle of the quadriceps, crossing both hip and knee. It flexes the hip and extends the knee.
rectus femoris.zh: 股四头肌的中央肌肉，跨越髋关节和膝关节。屈曲髋关节并伸展膝关节。

vastus lateralis.en: The largest component of the quadriceps, on the outer thigh. It extends the knee and stabilizes the patella.
vastus lateralis.zh: 股四头肌中最大的部分，位于大腿外侧。伸展膝关节并稳定髌骨。

vastus medialis.en: The inner component of the quadriceps. It extends the knee and is critical for the final degrees of knee extension and patellar tracking.
vastus medialis.zh: 股四头肌的内侧部分。伸展膝关节，对膝关节终末伸展和髌骨轨迹至关重要。

vastus intermedius.en: The deep central component of the quadriceps, lying beneath the rectus femoris. It extends the knee.
vastus intermedius.zh: 股四头肌的深层中央部分，位于股直肌下方。伸展膝关节。

biceps femoris.en: A two-headed muscle on the back of the thigh, part of the hamstrings. It flexes the knee and extends the hip.
biceps femoris.zh: 大腿后面的双头肌肉，属于腘绳肌群。屈曲膝关节并伸展髋关节。

semitendinosus.en: A long muscle on the posteromedial thigh, part of the hamstrings. It flexes the knee and extends the hip.
semitendinosus.zh: 大腿后内侧的长肌肉，属于腘绳肌群。屈曲膝关节并伸展髋关节。

semimembranosus.en: A broad muscle deep to the semitendinosus, part of the hamstrings. It flexes the knee, extends the hip, and medially rotates the tibia.
semimembranosus.zh: 半腱肌深层的宽阔肌肉，属于腘绳肌群。屈曲膝关节、伸展髋关节并内旋胫骨。

gastrocnemius.en: The prominent two-headed muscle of the calf. It plantarflexes the foot and assists knee flexion; essential for walking and jumping.
gastrocnemius.zh: 小腿后部突出的双头肌肉。使足跖屈并辅助膝关节屈曲；对行走和跳跃至关重要。

soleus.en: A broad flat muscle deep to the gastrocnemius. It plantarflexes the foot and is a key postural muscle during standing.
soleus.zh: 腓肠肌深层的宽阔扁平肌肉。使足跖屈，是站立时关键的姿势维持肌。

tibialis anterior.en: A muscle on the anterior shin. It dorsiflexes and inverts the foot, preventing foot-slap during walking.
tibialis anterior.zh: 胫骨前面的肌肉。使足背屈和内翻，防止行走时足部拍击地面。

sartorius.en: The longest muscle in the body, crossing from the hip to the inner knee. It flexes, abducts, and laterally rotates the hip.
sartorius.zh: 人体最长的肌肉，从髋部斜跨至膝内侧。使髋关节屈曲、外展和外旋。

gracilis.en: A thin strap-like muscle on the medial thigh. It adducts the thigh and assists knee flexion.
gracilis.zh: 大腿内侧的薄带状肌肉。使大腿内收并辅助膝关节屈曲。

adductor longus.en: A triangular muscle of the medial thigh. It adducts and assists in flexing and rotating the hip.
adductor longus.zh: 大腿内侧的三角形肌肉。使大腿内收，并辅助髋关节的屈曲和旋转。

adductor magnus.en: The largest adductor muscle, forming the bulk of the medial thigh. Its anterior fibers adduct and flex the hip; posterior fibers extend it.
adductor magnus.zh: 最大的内收肌，构成大腿内侧的主体。前部纤维使髋关节内收和屈曲；后部纤维使其伸展。

piriformis.en: A small muscle deep in the buttock, passing from sacrum to femur. It laterally rotates the extended hip and abducts the flexed hip.
piriformis.zh: 臀部深层的小肌肉，从骶骨延伸至股骨。伸髋时外旋，屈髋时外展。

iliopsoas.en: A composite of the psoas major and iliacus muscles. It is the strongest flexor of the hip joint.
iliopsoas.zh: 由腰大肌和髂肌组成的复合肌。是髋关节最强力的屈肌。

sternocleidomastoid.en: A prominent muscle on each side of the neck. Acting alone it tilts and rotates the head; acting together both sides flex the neck.
sternocleidomastoid.zh: 颈部两侧的突出肌肉。单侧作用使头侧倾和旋转；双侧同时作用屈曲颈部。

masseter.en: A thick rectangular muscle of the jaw. It elevates the mandible and is one of the strongest muscles for chewing.
masseter.zh: 下颌的厚矩形肌肉。提升下颌骨，是咀嚼时最强力的肌肉之一。

brachialis.en: A muscle beneath the biceps brachii. It is the primary flexor of the elbow regardless of forearm position.
brachialis.zh: 位于肱二头肌下方的肌肉。无论前臂位置如何，都是肘关节的主要屈肌。

brachioradialis.en: A forearm muscle forming the lateral border of the cubital fossa. It flexes the elbow, especially in a neutral forearm position.
brachioradialis.zh: 构成肘窝外侧缘的前臂肌肉。屈曲肘关节，尤其在前臂中立位时。

supraspinatus.en: A rotator cuff muscle above the scapular spine. It initiates arm abduction and stabilizes the humeral head in the glenoid.
supraspinatus.zh: 位于肩胛冈上方的肩袖肌肉。启动上臂外展并将肱骨头稳定在关节盂中。

infraspinatus.en: A rotator cuff muscle below the scapular spine. It laterally rotates the arm and stabilizes the shoulder joint.
infraspinatus.zh: 位于肩胛冈下方的肩袖肌肉。使上臂外旋并稳定肩关节。

serratus anterior.en: A fan-shaped muscle on the lateral chest wall. It protracts the scapula and holds it against the thorax; vital for pushing and punching.
serratus anterior.zh: 胸壁侧面的扇形肌肉。使肩胛骨前伸并紧贴胸廓；对推挤和挥拳动作至关重要。

erector spinae.en: A group of muscles running along the spine. They extend the vertebral column and maintain upright posture.
erector spinae.zh: 沿脊柱排列的一组肌肉。伸展脊柱并维持直立姿势。

fibularis longus.en: A muscle on the lateral lower leg. It everts and plantarflexes the foot and supports the transverse arch.
fibularis longus.zh: 小腿外侧的肌肉。使足外翻和跖屈，并支撑足横弓。

fibularis brevis.en: A muscle on the lateral lower leg deep to the fibularis longus. It everts and plantarflexes the foot.
fibularis brevis.zh: 腓骨长肌深层的小腿外侧肌肉。使足外翻和跖屈。

extensor digitorum longus.en: A muscle on the anterior leg. It extends the lateral four toes and dorsiflexes the foot.
extensor digitorum longus.zh: 小腿前面的肌肉。伸展外侧四趾并使足背屈。

flexor digitorum longus.en: A muscle on the posterior leg. It flexes the lateral four toes, aiding push-off during walking.
flexor digitorum longus.zh: 小腿后面的肌肉。屈曲外侧四趾，帮助行走时的蹬地动作。

flexor carpi radialis.en: A forearm muscle on the radial side. It flexes and abducts the wrist.
flexor carpi radialis.zh: 前臂桡侧的肌肉。使腕关节屈曲和外展。

flexor carpi ulnaris.en: A forearm muscle on the ulnar side. It flexes and adducts the wrist.
flexor carpi ulnaris.zh: 前臂尺侧的肌肉。使腕关节屈曲和内收。

extensor carpi radialis longus.en: A forearm muscle. It extends and abducts the wrist, and stabilizes the wrist during gripping.
extensor carpi radialis longus.zh: 前臂肌肉。使腕关节伸展和外展，并在握拳时稳定腕部。

extensor digitorum.en: A forearm muscle that extends the fingers at the metacarpophalangeal joints and assists wrist extension.
extensor digitorum.zh: 前臂肌肉。在掌指关节处伸展手指，并辅助腕关节伸展。

pronator teres.en: A forearm muscle crossing from medial humerus to the radius. It pronates the forearm and assists elbow flexion.
pronator teres.zh: 从肱骨内侧到桡骨的前臂肌肉。使前臂旋前并辅助肘关节屈曲。

levator scapulae.en: A muscle at the back and side of the neck. It elevates the scapula and tilts the glenoid inferiorly.
levator scapulae.zh: 颈部后外侧的肌肉。上提肩胛骨并使关节盂向下倾斜。

rhomboid major.en: A muscle between the spine and scapula. It retracts and elevates the scapula, stabilizing it during arm movements.
rhomboid major.zh: 位于脊柱和肩胛骨之间的肌肉。使肩胛骨后缩和上提，在上肢运动时稳定肩胛骨。

platysma.en: A thin sheet-like muscle in the superficial neck. It tenses the skin of the neck and depresses the lower lip.
platysma.zh: 颈部浅层的薄片状肌肉。绷紧颈部皮肤并降低下唇。

orbicularis oculi.en: The sphincter muscle around the eye. It closes the eyelids for blinking and squinting.
orbicularis oculi.zh: 眼睛周围的括约肌。使眼睑闭合，实现眨眼和眯眼。

temporalis.en: A fan-shaped muscle on the side of the skull. It elevates and retracts the mandible during chewing.
temporalis.zh: 颅骨侧面的扇形肌肉。在咀嚼时提升和后缩下颌骨。

sciatic nerve.en: The largest nerve in the body, running from the lower back through the buttock and down the leg. It supplies motor and sensory innervation to most of the lower limb.
sciatic nerve.zh: 人体最大的神经，从下背部经臀部延伸至下肢。为下肢大部分区域提供运动和感觉神经支配。

femoral nerve.en: A major nerve of the anterior thigh. It innervates the quadriceps and the skin of the anterior thigh and medial leg.
femoral nerve.zh: 大腿前部的主要神经。支配股四头肌以及大腿前面和小腿内侧的皮肤。

median nerve.en: A nerve of the upper limb passing through the carpal tunnel. It innervates most forearm flexors and the thenar muscles of the thumb.
median nerve.zh: 上肢神经，穿过腕管。支配前臂大部分屈肌和拇指的鱼际肌群。

ulnar nerve.en: A nerve running behind the medial epicondyle of the elbow ("funny bone"). It innervates intrinsic hand muscles and provides sensation to the little finger and ring finger.
ulnar nerve.zh: 沿肘内上髁后方走行的神经（"麻骨"）。支配手部固有肌，并提供小指和环指的感觉。

radial nerve.en: The nerve of the posterior arm and forearm. It innervates the triceps and all wrist and finger extensors.
radial nerve.zh: 上臂和前臂后侧的神经。支配肱三头肌以及所有腕部和手指伸肌。

musculocutaneous nerve.en: A nerve of the upper arm. It innervates the biceps brachii, brachialis, and coracobrachialis, and provides sensation to the lateral forearm.
musculocutaneous nerve.zh: 上臂的神经。支配肱二头肌、肱肌和喙肱肌，并提供前臂外侧的感觉。

axillary nerve.en: A nerve winding around the surgical neck of the humerus. It innervates the deltoid and teres minor muscles.
axillary nerve.zh: 绕肱骨外科颈走行的神经。支配三角肌和小圆肌。

tibial nerve.en: A branch of the sciatic nerve supplying the posterior leg and sole of the foot. It innervates the calf muscles and intrinsic foot muscles.
tibial nerve.zh: 坐骨神经的分支，支配小腿后部和足底。支配小腿肌肉和足底固有肌。

common fibular nerve.en: A branch of the sciatic nerve wrapping around the fibular neck. It innervates the anterior and lateral leg muscles for dorsiflexion and eversion.
common fibular nerve.zh: 坐骨神经的分支，绕腓骨颈走行。支配小腿前侧和外侧肌肉，负责背屈和外翻。

obturator nerve.en: A nerve of the lumbar plexus supplying the medial thigh. It innervates the adductor muscles and provides sensation to the medial thigh.
obturator nerve.zh: 腰丛的神经，支配大腿内侧。支配内收肌群并提供大腿内侧的感觉。

phrenic nerve.en: A nerve arising from cervical spinal nerves C3–C5. It is the sole motor supply to the diaphragm, essential for breathing.
phrenic nerve.zh: 起自颈神经C3-C5的神经。是膈肌唯一的运动神经供应，对呼吸至关重要。

vagus nerve.en: The longest cranial nerve, extending from the brainstem to the abdomen. It regulates heart rate, digestion, and other autonomic functions.
vagus nerve.zh: 最长的脑神经，从脑干延伸至腹部。调节心率、消化和其他自主神经功能。

facial nerve.en: The seventh cranial nerve. It controls the muscles of facial expression and carries taste sensation from the anterior tongue.
facial nerve.zh: 第七脑神经。控制面部表情肌，并传导舌前部的味觉。

trigeminal nerve.en: The fifth and largest cranial nerve. It provides sensation to the face and motor innervation to the muscles of mastication.
trigeminal nerve.zh: 第五脑神经，也是最大的脑神经。提供面部感觉和咀嚼肌的运动神经支配。

optic nerve.en: The second cranial nerve carrying visual information from the retina to the brain.
optic nerve.zh: 第二脑神经，将视网膜的视觉信息传递至大脑。

spinal cord.en: The cylindrical bundle of nerve fibers within the vertebral canal. It relays signals between the brain and the body and contains reflex circuits.
spinal cord.zh: 椎管内的圆柱状神经纤维束。在大脑和身体之间传递信号，并包含反射回路。

brachial plexus.en: A network of nerves formed by ventral rami of C5–T1 spinal nerves. It gives rise to the nerves supplying the upper limb.
brachial plexus.zh: 由C5-T1脊神经前支组成的神经网络。产生支配上肢的各条神经。

atlas.en: The first cervical vertebra (C1), supporting the skull. It allows the nodding motion of the head.
